pairs.target: dào dìèrtiān zǎoshàng , xiāngzǐ réng méiyǒu dǎkāi .
pairs.english: The next morning, the cases were still unopened.
pairs.hanzi: 到第二天早上，箱子仍没有打开。

pairs.target: tǎ wéi bǎ zuóyè xiě de nà zhāng biǎo dú le liǎngbiàn , xiǎng tiān shàng jiù péng tiě yàng hòulái zěnyàng , yòu bù zhīdào gāi xiě shénme . tā zhǐjiàn guò kèxiàn nuókāi , méiyǒu zhàn zài lán lǐ dú guòshù .
pairs.english: Tavi read last night’s sheet twice, wanting to add what had happened to the old shed’s iron samples, but not knowing what to write. He had only seen the marks shift, never stood inside the barrier to read them.
pairs.hanzi: 塔维把昨夜写的那张表读了两遍，想添上旧棚铁样后来怎样，又不知道该写什么。他只见过刻线挪开，没有站在栏里读过数。

pairs.target: zuìhòu tā lìng qǐ yìháng , xiě zìjǐ shénme shíhòu bèi jiàotíng , bānzǒu le nǎxiē dōngxī .
pairs.english: Finally he began a new line, recording when he had been stopped and what he had moved away.
pairs.hanzi: 最后他另起一行，写自己什么时候被叫停，搬走了哪些东西。

pairs.target: shí yán guòlái , wèn tā yǒuméiyǒu yào dàihuí chéng de shī yī . tā shuō yǒu , shí yán jiào tā xiān juàn zài lìng yíkuài bùlǐ , bié gēn gān tú sāi dào yìqǐ .
pairs.english: Shiyan came over and asked about wet clothes for the return journey. Tavi said yes; Shiyan told him to roll them in a separate cloth, away from the dry drawings.
pairs.hanzi: 石延过来，问他有没有要带回城的湿衣。他说有，石延叫他先卷在另一块布里，别跟干图塞到一起。

pairs.target: tǎ wéi běn yǐwéi jīntiān yào qǔxiāo huíchéng , tīngjiàn zhèhuà , fǎndǎo yìshí méi dá .
pairs.english: Tavi had thought today’s return would be cancelled; hearing this, he could not answer for a moment.
pairs.hanzi: 塔维本以为今天要取消回程，听见这话，反倒一时没答。

pairs.target: ruì shīfu cóng péng hòu chūlái , ràng tāmen bǎ yǐjīng zuò wán de héngtiáo hé kòujiàn qīngdiǎn hǎo , zhuāngjìn liúzài zhèlǐ de mùxiāng . xiàwǔ zhào yuándìng huíchéng , xīn táishàng de pèiduì tiě lìng dàizǒu , jiù péng búzài shìzhuāng .
pairs.english: Master Rui came from behind the shed and had them count the completed crossbars and clasps into a wooden crate staying here. They would return that afternoon as planned, taking the new platform’s iron pair separately; no more trial fitting in the old shed.
pairs.hanzi: 芮师傅从棚后出来，让他们把已经做完的横条和扣件清点好，装进留在这里的木箱。下午照原定回城，新台上的配对铁另带走，旧棚不再试装。

pairs.target: " nà kuàng ne ? " tǎ wéi wèn . " kuàng zuòhǎo le . zhuāngshàngqù hái méi suàn wán . "
pairs.english: “And the frames?” Tavi asked. “The frames are built. Fitting them is not finished.”
pairs.hanzi:
“那框呢？”塔维问。
“框做好了。装上去还没算完。”

pairs.target: tā méiyǒu bìkāi tā de wèntí , jiào tā bǎ nà zhī méiyǒu yòng guò de tiě jiǎo fàngzài yìpáng , bùxǔ hùnjìn chéngpǐn . nà shì qú biān yuánlái de dōngxī , bú zài zhècì hézhǔn de xiǎo tiě duì lǐ .
pairs.english: She did not evade his question, telling him to set the unused iron hinge aside, never mixing it with finished work. It belonged to the old channel equipment, outside this approved small iron pair.
pairs.hanzi: 她没有避开他的问题，叫他把那只没有用过的铁铰放在一旁，不许混进成品。那是渠边原来的东西，不在这次核准的小铁对里。

pairs.target: zuótiān yǒurén xiǎng jiè tā shì wèizhì , shuǐ yìlái tíng le , rújīn gèng bùnéng zhàojiù ná qǐlái .
pairs.english: Someone had wanted it for checking positions yesterday, but the rising water stopped that; now it certainly could not be handled as before.
pairs.hanzi: 昨天有人想借它试位置，水一来停了，如今更不能照旧拿起来。

pairs.target: nài lěi dào jìn wǔ cái huílái . tā tóng zhíshǒu de lǎogōngrén chá guò lāgān hòu de jiù chéng tái , fāxiàn yìzǔ yìzhí méiyǒu fùwèi dàodǐ de jiù pèijiàn , zài zuótiān kāizhá shí dòng guò .
pairs.english: Nerai returned near noon. With the elderly keeper, she had inspected the old support behind the lever: an old component group that had never fully reset had moved when yesterday’s sluice opened.
pairs.hanzi: 奈蕾到近午才回来。她同值守的老工人查过拉杆后的旧承台，发现一组一直没有复位到底的旧配件，在昨天开闸时动过。

pairs.target: jiù péng yuánlái jièzhe nàduàn chéng tái zhī jiǎo , bùnéng yīnwèi shàngmiàn xīn huàn le mùbǎn , jiùsuàn yǔ tā méiguānxì .
pairs.english: The old shed rested on part of that support; new boards above did not make it independent.
pairs.hanzi: 旧棚原来借着那段承台支脚，不能因为上面新换了木板，就算与它没关系。

pairs.target: tǎ wéi wèn shìbushì zhǐyào bǎ nà zǔ pèijiàn chāikāi jiù hǎo le .
pairs.english: Tavi asked whether dismantling that component group would solve it.
pairs.hanzi: 塔维问是不是只要把那组配件拆开就好了。

pairs.target: nài lěi yáotóu , shuō qiān zhe zhá , bùnéng zhào chāi yíkuài fèitiě de bànfǎ lái .
pairs.english: Nerai shook her head: it was tied to the sluice, not something to dismantle like scrap iron.
pairs.hanzi: 奈蕾摇头，说牵着闸，不能照拆一块废铁的办法来。

pairs.target: tāmen xiànzài néng dìng de shì , jiù péng nà yídài de jǐchù tiě yàng quèshí gēnzhe biàn , xīn tái yán miànshàng lìng shè de jiǎn yàng méiyǒu tóngyàng biànhuà .
pairs.english: What they could now establish was that several iron samples around the old shed changed with it, while separate test samples on the new platform’s bedrock did not show the same change.
pairs.hanzi: 她们现在能定的是，旧棚那一带的几处铁样确实跟着变，新台岩面上另设的检样没有同样变化。

pairs.target: fànwéi hái dé jìxù chá , yě hái bùnéng shuō zǎo kāishuǐ hé pèijiàn biànhuà zhījiān , měi yíbù dōu dǒng le .
pairs.english: The range still needed investigation; they could not yet claim to understand every step between the early release and the component changes.
pairs.hanzi: 范围还得继续查，也还不能说早开水和配件变化之间，每一步都懂了。

pairs.target: tā shuō zhèxiē shí , shǒulǐ ná zhe xīn huà de biānjiè tú , zhǐ shàng zhǐyǒu yìxiǎokuài dìfāng tú le huī , pángbiān réng liú zhe hěnduō wèi xiě de kōng .
pairs.english: As she spoke, she held a newly drawn boundary sketch, only a small patch shaded grey, with much unwritten space beside it.
pairs.hanzi: 她说这些时，手里拿着新画的边界图，纸上只有一小块地方涂了灰，旁边仍留着很多未写的空。

pairs.target: tǎ wéi xiǎngqǐ zìjǐ dìyītiān kànjiàn de jùdà qiángmiàn . dìtú shàng liúbái , bù yídìng shì yuǎn dé qù bùliǎo de dìfāng ; yǒushí jiù zài gébì , rén rìrì cǎi zhe , yě méiyǒu quán kànqīng .
pairs.english: Tavi remembered the enormous wall from his first day. Blank map space need not mean an unreachable distance; sometimes it was next door, walked on daily and still not fully understood.
pairs.hanzi: 塔维想起自己第一天看见的巨大墙面。地图上留白，不一定是远得去不了的地方；有时就在隔壁，人日日踩着，也没有全看清。

pairs.target: yuè qín tīng wán , shuō nà tā jīntiān dé gàosù chuánshàng de rén , xīn de kuàng zànshí bùnéng zhuāng , jiù de yě bùnéng luàn pèng . tā jiāng shībù wǎng jiānshàng yì dā , wèn tāmen huíchéng yǐhòu , zhèlǐ shuí lái shǒu .
pairs.english: Yueqin said she would tell the boat people today that the new frames could not yet be fitted and the old ones must not be touched casually. Draping a wet cloth on her shoulder, she asked who would watch here after they returned to the city.
pairs.hanzi: 月芹听完，说那她今天得告诉船上的人，新的框暂时不能装，旧的也不能乱碰。她将湿布往肩上一搭，问他们回城以后，这里谁来守。

pairs.target: ruì shīfu shuō zhànshàng liúxià liǎngmíng hégé gōngrén , jiù lánwài zài jiā yídào shéng , xīn tái jīntiān yě bù kāi jiāohuàn .
pairs.english: Master Rui said two qualified station workers would stay, with another rope outside the old barrier; no exchange work on the new platform today either.
pairs.hanzi: 芮师傅说站上留下两名合格工人，旧栏外再加一道绳，新台今天也不开交换。

pairs.target: páng qú xiān yòng yǐjīng jiǎnchá guò de mù dǎng , kào rén qīnglǐ , guò chuán de kuānzhǎi zhào línshí liáng dìng de nà yídàng , bùnéngzìjǐ nuó . xiū péng chū de zhè jǐtiān kānshǒu qián , tā huì zài jiāojiē dān shàng xiěmíng .
pairs.english: The side channel would use inspected wooden barriers, cleaned by hand, with boat clearance at the temporarily measured setting, never shifted independently. She would record the depot’s payment for these days of watching on the handover sheet.
pairs.hanzi: 旁渠先用已经检查过的木挡，靠人清理，过船的宽窄照临时量定的那一档，不能自己挪。修棚出的这几天看守钱，她会在交接单上写明。

alignment.english: payment for these days of watching

pairs.target: " xiěmíng le , shuí gěi ? " yuè qín wèn . " zhànshàng . "
pairs.english: “Record it, and who pays?” Yueqin asked. “The station.”
pairs.hanzi:
“写明了，谁给？”月芹问。
“站上。”

pairs.target: tā kànzhe ruì shīfu , děng duìfāng bǎ nà liǎnggè zì luòdào zhǐ shàng , cái zhuǎnshēn jiào xièhuò de rén guòlái tīng .
pairs.english: She watched Master Rui until those words were on paper, then turned to call the unloaders over to hear.
pairs.hanzi: 她看着芮师傅，等对方把那两个字落到纸上，才转身叫卸货的人过来听。

pairs.target: tǎ wéi zhècì méiyǒu xiān juéde tā tài bú fàngxīn . pénglǐ yǒurén yào gǎnhuíqù shàngkè , yǒurén míngtiān réng yào kào zhè tiáo shuǐ chīfàn , sànchǎng búshì yì huíshì .
pairs.english: This time Tavi did not first think her overcautious. Some in the shed had classes to return to; others would still earn their living on this water tomorrow. Finishing meant different things.
pairs.hanzi: 塔维这次没有先觉得她太不放心。棚里有人要赶回去上课，有人明天仍要靠这条水吃饭，散场不是一回事。

pairs.target: wǔhòu mùxiāng qīngdiǎn wán , shí yán qǔchū zǎoshàng nàgēn tiě jiǎo , dāndú bāo hǎo , jiāogěi liúxià de rén .
pairs.english: After the afternoon crate count, Shiyan took out the iron hinge, wrapped it separately and handed it to those staying.
pairs.hanzi: 午后木箱清点完，石延取出早上那根铁铰，单独包好，交给留下的人。

pairs.target: tǎ wéi kàn tā bú dà , hé zìjǐ shǒulǐ nàxiē zuò guò de dōngxī méi chà duōshǎo , jìng dé kào yìzhāng yòu yìzhāng qīngchǔ de zhǐ , cái búzhìyú bǎ tāmen suàn chéng yíyàng .
pairs.english: Tavi saw it was small, much like things he had worked on, yet it took sheet after clear sheet to keep them from being treated as the same.
pairs.hanzi: 塔维看它不大，和自己手里那些做过的东西没差多少，竟得靠一张又一张清楚的纸，才不至于把它们算成一样。

pairs.target: zhuāngchē shí , nài lěi bǎ zuìhòu yíjuàn tú héng fàngdào zuò hòu , méiyǒu zuòshànglái . tā háiyào liú dào jiāojiē wán , gēn zhànshàng de rén duō chá liǎngtiān , zài cóng yuán lù huílái .
pairs.english: While loading, Nerai laid the last drawing roll behind the seat but did not climb aboard. She would stay for the handover, inspect with the station staff two more days, then return by the same road.
pairs.hanzi: 装车时，奈蕾把最后一卷图横放到座后，没有坐上来。她还要留到交接完，跟站上的人多查两天，再从原路回来。

pairs.target: ruì shīfu dài zhuāngpèi duì huíchéng , jiù zhá nàbiān de shì guī tā jiēzhe bàn .
pairs.english: Master Rui would take the assembly crew back; the old sluice remained Nerai’s work.
pairs.hanzi: 芮师傅带装配队回城，旧闸那边的事归她接着办。

pairs.target: tǎ wéi xiǎng wèn tā huì buhuì hěn lèi , què tīngjiàn yuè qín xiān wèn , tā zhù de nà jiān wūlòu bu lòu . nài lěi shuō chuāng jiǎo dīshuǐ , yuè qín mà le yíjù , jiào tā jīnwǎn huàn dào gāoqiáng hòumiàn qù , nàbiān kōng le yìzhāng chuáng .
pairs.english: Tavi wanted to ask if she would be tired, but Yueqin first asked whether her room leaked. Nerai said the window corner dripped; Yueqin swore and told her to move behind the tall wall tonight, where a bed was free.
pairs.hanzi: 塔维想问她会不会很累，却听见月芹先问，她住的那间屋漏不漏。奈蕾说窗角滴水，月芹骂了一句，叫她今晚换到高墙后面去，那边空了一张床。

pairs.target: chē chū xiū péng shí , ànshàng yǒu gè háizi jǔ zhe yìzhī qiǎn pén jiē yán shuǐ . tǎ wéiduō kàn le yìyǎn , pén hěn pǔtōng , liǎnggè ěr , yídào quēkǒu .
pairs.english: As the cart left the depot, a child on the bank held a shallow basin under dripping eaves. Tavi looked again: an ordinary basin, two lugs and a chip.
pairs.hanzi: 车出修棚时，岸上有个孩子举着一只浅盆接檐水。塔维多看了一眼，盆很普通，两个耳，一道缺口。

pairs.target: tā hūrán jì qǐ kàn zhǎn nàtiān de nǚrén , yòu xiǎngqǐ zìjǐ dāying yīwén jì wǎnfàn .
pairs.english: He remembered the exhibition visitor, then his promise to Iven to record dinners.
pairs.hanzi: 他忽然记起看展那天的女人，又想起自己答应伊文记晚饭。

pairs.target: huíchéng de lùmiàn yǐjīng shài chū qiǎnsè , chē ràoguò zǎochén chá guò de pō wān , yán láishí tōngxíng de chēdào wǎng shàng . shí yán kàozhe xiāngzǐ shuìzháo le , zuǐ wēizhāng , xiàng háiyào zàishuō yíjù yán zhòng .
pairs.english: The return road had dried pale. The cart rounded the slope bend checked that morning and climbed the same open cart road. Shiyan slept against a crate, mouth slightly open as if about to complain about the salt again.
pairs.hanzi: 回程的路面已经晒出浅色，车绕过早晨查过的坡弯，沿来时通行的车道往上。石延靠着箱子睡着了，嘴微张，像还要再说一句盐重。

pairs.target: tǎ wéi jiāng běnzi fàngdào tuǐ shàng , xiěxià jīntiān dàihuíqù de dōngxī : liǎngzhī jiājù xiāng , yífèn zhuāng hǎo de huó , yífèn méi zhuāng hǎo de huó , háiyǒu yuè qín wèn de nà jù , shuí gěi .
pairs.english: Tavi put his notebook on his knees and listed what he was bringing back: two fixture cases, work completed, work not completed, and Yueqin’s question, who pays.
pairs.hanzi: 塔维将本子放到腿上，写下今天带回去的东西：两只夹具箱，一份装好的活，一份没装好的活，还有月芹问的那句，谁给。

pairs.target: xiě wán , tā bǎ zhǐ ànzhù , méiyǒu ràng yíngmiàn de fēng fān huí zuótiān .
pairs.english: When he finished, he held the paper down, keeping the oncoming wind from turning it back to yesterday.
pairs.hanzi: 写完，他把纸按住，没有让迎面的风翻回昨天。
